Option Explicit
Sub Main()
  Dim texts() As String, text As Variant, row As Long
  ReDim texts(1 To 2)
  texts(1) = "  alpha"
  texts(2) = "  beta"
  row = 1
  For Each text In texts
    If Len(text) > 2 Then
      Worksheets(1).Cells(row,1).Value2 = Tail(text)
    End If
    row = row + 1
  Next text
End Sub
Function Tail(ByVal text As String) As String
  Tail = Mid$(text,3)
End Function
